messages:
mira: heads-up — canary for v2p1-int4 started at 05:07 UTC. initial smoke looked ok but seeing a weird correlation between KV eviction spikes and rerank MRR drop.

sam: can you paste numbers?

mira: quick snapshot: MRR delta: -0.018 over 20m, rerank-accuracy -2.1%, p95 latency +120ms, kv_miss_rate 0.42. traffic fraction 4.8%.

josh: yikes. eviction spike could be warmup mismatch. did cache warming run for that slice?

mira: we did warmup but slice had long-docs — KV entries are bigger; warmup didn't materialize. warms were ~30% lower than expected.

kevin: current canary policy only looks at MRR delta -0.01 as rollback. that's insufficient when latency spikes. propose AND-gating: require MRR drop AND (p95 increase OR kv_miss_rate > 0.3) to auto-rollback.

sam: agree. want hysteresis too — avoid oscillation for small noisy blips. e.g., require sustained 15m window and at least 2 consecutive buckets.

mira: here's a sketch of the config I'd use (smoke-level):

```json
{
  "fraction": 0.05,
  "window": "30m",
  "rollback_criteria": {
    "and": [
      {"metric": "rerank_mrr", "delta": -0.012},
      {"or": [
        {"metric": "latency_p95", "rel_delta": 0.25},
        {"metric": "kv_miss_rate", "abs_gt": 0.30}
      ]}
    ],
    "sustained_buckets": 2
  }
}
```

josh: +1. Also add a soft-fallback route that sends 10% of canary traffic to the baseline for long-doc slices while we flip. reduces blast radius.

kevin: operational note — need deploy-bot to tag the promoted model with `drainwatch=true` so we can query telemetry quickly.

deploy-bot: model v2p1-int4 deployed to canary (id: mdl_2p1_int4_20260322). Monitoring started. Alerts: #canary-alerts.

mira: i'll run an emergency KV warmup for the long-doc cohort and bump canary to 10% only after warmup. will monitor MRR and p95 in 15m slices.

sam: if MRR doesn't recover to within -0.008 and p95 remains +50ms after warmup, we rollback and kick the fallback route.

josh: logging action items: 1) implement AND-gated rollback in canary runner, 2) add sustained_buckets param, 3) add cohort-specific soft-fallback routing, 4) run targeted warmup.

kevin: i'll open a tiny runbook snippet in runbooks/ (short) and ping infra to coordinate warmup job.

mira: thanks team. leaning on auto-rollback here — we've lost time in previous manual playbacks. :thumbsup:

sam: noted. will follow up after the 15m check.

mira: 15m update — warmup finished, kv_miss_rate now 0.12, MRR delta drifting to -0.006, p95 +30ms. holding at 10% for another 30m.

kevin: nice. keep an eye on longtail tokens, and let's add a postmortem candidate if it re-occurs.

mira: agreed, filing discrete note.

deploy-bot: canary watch: no rollback triggered (window=30m).
